name: Zephaniah
title: The Prophet of Judgment
summary: Zephaniah was of royal lineage, a descendant of King Hezekiah. He prophesied during the early reign of King Josiah, before the great reformation. His message about the Day of the Lord as a day of wrath and judgment helped prepare the people for Josiah's reforms.

keyEvents.title: The Day of the Lord
keyEvents.description: Zephaniah proclaimed the Day of the Lord as a day of wrath, distress, and destruction.

keyEvents.title: Call to Repentance
keyEvents.description: Zephaniah urged the people to seek the Lord, to pursue righteousness and humility.

keyEvents.title: Judgment on the Nations
keyEvents.description: Zephaniah prophesied judgment against Judah's neighboring nations and ultimately over the whole earth.

keyEvents.title: The Promise of Restoration
keyEvents.description: Zephaniah concluded with a beautiful promise that God will save and rejoice over His people.
